title: Sheehan gets an injunction against the Scientology grand jury subpoenas

tellings.quote: me again and I went up to New York CU I'm admitted in the southern district and I got an injunction shutting them down

plain: In the 1970s, a lawyer named Dan Sheehan says, grand jury subpoenas aimed at the Church of Scientology were stopped by a court order he won himself. He tells Michels that he went up to New York, where he is admitted to practise in the federal court for the Southern District, and "got an injunction shutting them down." He tells it as a lawyer who took part, and if it happened as he says, he personally blocked a federal investigation in its tracks.
